title: No repository-wide git worktree prune in core tooling
goal: local-workflow's clear_candidate and local-release's gate-tool checkout forget only their own worktree record instead of running a bare `git worktree prune`, which on this shared NTFS drive also deletes the records of live worktrees registered from the Windows boot (gitdir F:/..., a missing relative path to Linux Git); board item 147
results: new xtask/src/worktree_admin.rs: forget(root, checkout) removes only the .git/worktrees record whose gitdir names the removed checkout; locked and unreadable records are kept
tests: forgets_only_the_record_of_the_removed_checkout, a_locked_record_is_kept, a_bare_prune_would_also_delete_the_windows_record (demonstrates the hazard with real git 2.56)
cargo test -p xtask --bin local-workflow: 186 passed, 0 failed; --features release-tooling --bin local-release: 100 passed, 0 failed, 2 ignored (pre-existing)
strict clippy on xtask (all features, all targets) exit 0; workspace check exit 0
limitations: does not prove what deleted the whole susi/.git/worktrees directory at 11:31 IST on 2026-11-11: Linux-registered records were lost too, which a bare prune does not explain
commercial `susi-commercial workflow prune` not audited here
